description: This file defines macros, classes, and functions for tracing and performance measurement, including event recording, counters, asynchronous events, and sampling states, used for application profiling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TraceID
classes.description: Encapsulates an ID that can be an integer or pointer, with pointer IDs mangled with process ID for uniqueness.

classes.name: TraceValueUnion
classes.description: Union to store various argument types for trace events.

classes.name: TraceStringWithCopy
classes.description: Wrapper for const char* to indicate it should be copied when used in trace events.

classes.name: TraceEndOnScopeClose
classes.description: Helper class to automatically add an end event when a scope ends.

methods.name: setTraceValue
methods.description: Template functions to set trace argument values of various types, storing type info and value.

methods.name: addTraceEvent
methods.description: Functions to add trace events with 0, 1, or 2 arguments, handling different argument types.
